name: Barov Family Fortune

narrative.details:
My dear brother Alexi. What a fool I was to spare his life. I looked into the face of the enemy, one of the undead, and let him live.

<Weldon spits.>

He now searches for MY inheritance. This simply cannot happen.

Find my family's deeds before that vile retch gets his boney hands upon them and I shall reward you with vast riches. They lay in the ruins of the Scholomance. Make haste!
narrative.objectives: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent work, friend. Now to secure my inheritance...
narrative.requestItemsText: Bow your head in my presence, friend. I am a noble, after all, and you are a copperless peasant.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 14,900 XP in all.
